Sometimes I catch a fish or a frog in the shallows. I drink slowly, with my head low, and then I fly back to the oak. Hoo... hoo-hoo-hooo.

I eat them whole, bones and all. I do not like voles. They are too big and too far away. I prefer the mice.

Mice. I catch them in the meadow, in the field, in the ditch. They are small and quick, but I hear them. I hear the rustle of their tails, the scratch of their paws. I wait, then drop.
